_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v10: v9 plus the regenerated GraphQL document. v9 shipped the template and composable but NOT the query — the .graphql fragment is only codegen input, and codegen aborts on this platform because an unrelated 2.51.1 query (getOrganizationContacts) passes an organizationId argument the platform's Profile xAPI does not accept. The GetFullOrder document in types.ts is therefore patched directly: shipments gain id/number/status/statusDisplayValue/trackingNumber/trackingUrl/deliveryDate and the order gains dynamicProperties. Verified in the built bundle before shipping.
